title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Nimbus Labs builds retrieval-augmented assistants for enterprise support teams. You will own the model-serving stack end to end, from latency budgets to the evaluation harnesses that turn production traffic into training data. The role sits between research and platform, and you will ship measurable quality gains every sprint.
responsibilities: Design and operate low-latency inference services for LLM and embedding workloads
Build offline and online evaluation pipelines for retrieval and generation quality
Tune retrieval, reranking, and prompt templates against live traffic
Partner with product to define and hit quality and cost targets

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Larkspur Analytics helps insurers price risk with structured and text data. You will build and ship supervised models that feed underwriting decisions and keep them healthy in production. Expect an even split between feature work, model iteration, and monitoring.
responsibilities: Train and validate gradient-boosted and linear models for pricing tasks
Engineer features from claims history, documents, and third-party feeds
Package models behind a prediction API and monitor drift
Write clear model cards and hand off to actuarial reviewers

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Perception
description: Meridian Robotics builds warehouse picking arms that see and grasp novel objects. As staff engineer on perception you set the technical direction for the vision stack and mentor a team of six. You will balance research bets against the reliability bar of a physical product on customer floors.
responsibilities: Own the architecture of the object detection and pose-estimation pipeline
Set evaluation standards and regression gates for on-robot models
Guide build-versus-adapt decisions for foundation vision models
Mentor engineers and review designs across the perception group
Drive latency and accuracy targets for real-time inference on edge hardware

title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Fathomline builds speech analytics for contact centers. You will join the modeling team and work on transcription cleanup, topic tagging, and sentiment scoring under close mentorship. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who wants to learn production ML.
responsibilities: Prototype text-classification models from labeled call transcripts
Build data-cleaning and labeling helper scripts
Run experiments and summarize results for the team
Add unit tests and documentation for shipped components

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
description: Solenoid AI runs a managed inference platform for open-weight language models. As principal engineer you will define the serving architecture that keeps GPU utilization high while meeting tenant latency SLAs. You will work across batching, autoscaling, and capacity, and represent the company in technical conversations with large customers.
responsibilities: Set the multi-year technical roadmap for the inference platform
Design continuous-batching and paged-attention serving paths
Establish benchmarks for throughput, latency, and cost per token
Advise leadership on hardware and capacity strategy
Review the hardest designs across the platform organization

title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth
description: Brightkelp Data runs a subscription commerce platform and needs a senior data scientist to own growth experimentation. You will design the experiment framework, build causal models of retention, and turn findings into roadmap bets. The role reports into data and partners daily with product and marketing.
responsibilities: Design and analyze A/B and holdout experiments end to end
Build retention and lifetime-value models from behavioral data
Define north-star and guardrail metrics with product leaders
Publish readouts that change what the team builds next

title: Data Scientist
description: Verdanttech Systems builds energy-monitoring hardware and software for commercial buildings. You will forecast consumption, flag anomalies, and help customers cut waste. The data is time-series heavy and the models ship into a customer-facing dashboard.
responsibilities: Build load-forecasting models across thousands of building meters
Develop anomaly detection for equipment faults and billing errors
Package models as scheduled jobs with clear alerting
Collaborate with firmware and frontend on data contracts

title: Data Scientist, Clinical Analytics
description: Pinecrest Health Data helps hospital networks measure care quality. You will build cohort definitions, risk-adjustment models, and readmission predictors from claims and EHR extracts. Rigor and reproducibility matter more than novelty here.
responsibilities: Define patient cohorts and quality measures from messy clinical data
Fit and calibrate risk models with documented assumptions
Validate results with clinicians and revise accordingly
Keep analyses reproducible with versioned notebooks and data snapshots

title: Data Science Intern
description: Glasswing Studio is a product studio building consumer mobile apps. As a data science intern you will help analyze onboarding funnels and draft dashboards for the founding team. You will be paired with a senior mentor for the full term.
responsibilities: Pull and clean event data for funnel and cohort analyses
Build charts and short written summaries for weekly reviews
Prototype a churn-signal model as an end-of-term project

title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace
description: Driftwood ML operates a two-sided marketplace for freelance trades work. You will model supply-demand balance, price guidance, and match quality. Your work directly moves take rate and fill rate, and you will own those metrics with the marketplace pod.
responsibilities: Model geographic supply and demand to guide incentive spend
Build price-recommendation models for job postings
Design experiments for matching and ranking changes
Translate ambiguous marketplace questions into measurable analyses

title: Senior Applied Research Scientist, NLP
description: Thornbury Research builds domain-specific language models for legal workflows. You will run applied research on retrieval, long-context reasoning, and citation faithfulness, then work with engineers to land the wins in the product. Publication is encouraged but shipping is the goal.
responsibilities: Design and run experiments on retrieval and long-context methods
Build evaluation sets that reflect real legal review tasks
Prototype fine-tuning and adapter approaches for domain data
Write up findings and pair with engineering on productionization

title: Principal Research Scientist, Multimodal
description: Northwind Vision develops multimodal models for industrial inspection. As principal scientist you will set the research agenda across vision-language pretraining and few-shot adaptation for new defect types. You will guide a team of researchers and own the bridge to the deployment group.
responsibilities: Define a multi-quarter research agenda for multimodal perception
Advise on pretraining data, architecture, and evaluation strategy
Mentor researchers and raise the bar on experimental rigor
Represent the science in customer and partner discussions
Prioritize research bets against deployment constraints

title: Applied Scientist, Forecasting
description: Maplecore builds inventory planning software for mid-market retailers. You will research and ship demand-forecasting models that handle intermittent sales, promotions, and new products. The role is split between method work and careful backtesting against client data.
responsibilities: Develop hierarchical and probabilistic forecasting models
Build rigorous backtests and error-decomposition tooling
Handle cold-start and promotion effects explicitly
Document methods so client analysts can trust the output

title: Staff Research Engineer, Optimization
description: Halcyon Systems builds routing and scheduling software for logistics fleets. As staff research engineer you will own the solver stack that turns operational constraints into vehicle plans. The work mixes operations research, heuristics, and a lot of profiling.
responsibilities: Design and implement metaheuristics for large routing problems
Build a benchmark suite over anonymized customer instances
Profile and optimize the hot paths of the solver
Guide the team on modeling tradeoffs and solution quality

title: Backend Engineer, Platform APIs
description: Coppertrace provides supply-chain traceability APIs to food and pharma brands. You will build and maintain the public REST and event APIs that customers integrate against. Reliability, clear contracts, and good docs are the core of the job.
responsibilities: Design and ship versioned REST endpoints with strong validation
Own background workers for ingest and webhook delivery
Write integration tests and keep the OpenAPI spec accurate
Support customers through integration issues with the API

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Slateharbor builds billing infrastructure for usage-based SaaS companies. You will work on the metering pipeline and the invoice engine, where correctness under load is non-negotiable. Expect deep work on idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails.
responsibilities: Design the metering ingestion and aggregation pipeline
Build the invoice generation and reconciliation services
Harden money-path code with property and load tests
Lead design reviews and mentor two mid-level engineers

title: Junior Backend Engineer
description: Zephyrine Software builds scheduling tools for home-services businesses. You will pick up well-scoped backend tickets across the API and job queue with support from senior engineers. It is a good spot to grow solid fundamentals in a small team.
responsibilities: Implement CRUD endpoints and background tasks from clear specs
Write unit and integration tests for your changes
Fix bugs reported by support with guidance on root-causing
Keep API docs and changelogs up to date

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
description: Cindershift runs a payout platform for European gig marketplaces. You will own services that move money across borders, handle FX, and stay within regulatory limits. The team values careful design docs and thorough testing over speed.
responsibilities: Build and operate payout, ledger, and reconciliation services
Model FX and fee logic with strong test coverage
Integrate new banking and KYC partners behind clean interfaces
Participate in on-call for the payments domain

title: Backend Engineer
description: Maplecore's platform team keeps the inventory planning product fast and dependable. You will work on the data-sync services that pull from retail point-of-sale systems and normalize them for the forecasting engine. Expect a lot of integration work and queue tuning.
responsibilities: Build connectors to third-party retail and ERP systems
Own the ingestion queue and its retry and dead-letter handling
Add observability so sync failures are caught before customers notice
Write runbooks for the on-call rotation

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trading Systems
description: Ironwood Exchange operates a spot exchange for carbon credits. You will build low-latency order-matching and settlement services where every millisecond and every cent is audited. The bar for testing and observability on this team is very high.
responsibilities: Develop the matching engine and post-trade settlement services
Design for deterministic replay and full auditability
Load-test and profile the critical path under peak volume
Review designs and coach engineers on concurrency patterns

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Sunfish Interactive builds analytics dashboards for e-commerce operators. You will own large parts of the React app, from data-heavy tables to the chart components. Performance with big datasets in the browser is a recurring theme.
responsibilities: Build and maintain complex data tables and visualizations
Improve render performance for large result sets
Collaborate with design on a consistent component library
Write component tests and visual regression checks

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Design Systems
description: Emberline AI is a creative-tools startup building a browser-based editor. As senior frontend engineer you will own the design system and the accessibility story across a fast-moving product. You will set patterns other engineers build on every day.
responsibilities: Own the component library, theming, and accessibility guidelines
Drive adoption of shared patterns across product teams
Profile and fix rendering and interaction performance issues
Mentor engineers on frontend architecture and testing

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
description: Glasswing Studio ships consumer mobile and web apps for early-stage founders. You will build UI from Figma files, wire up APIs, and fix bugs across several small products. Mentorship and code review are part of the daily rhythm.
responsibilities: Implement responsive screens from design specs
Connect components to REST endpoints and handle loading and error states
Write unit tests for shared components
Address bugs and polish items from QA

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Polderworks builds public-transit planning tools used by Dutch municipalities. You will work on map-heavy interfaces where clarity and accessibility are legal requirements, not nice-to-haves. The stack is Vue with a strong testing culture.
responsibilities: Build interactive map and timetable interfaces
Meet WCAG accessibility standards across all new work
Write end-to-end tests for critical planning flows
Work with GIS data providers on frontend data formats

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: Kestrelbyte makes developer-facing observability tooling. You will lead frontend work on the query builder and trace-explorer views, which handle large streaming datasets. You will also help shape the API contracts you consume.
responsibilities: Own the trace-explorer and query-builder front ends
Design streaming-data rendering that stays responsive under load
Partner with backend on efficient API shapes
Set frontend testing and release standards for the team

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description: Shamrock Digital builds membership and events software for trade associations. You will work across a TypeScript stack, shipping features from database to UI. The team is small, so ownership is broad and shipping cadence is weekly.
responsibilities: Deliver features end to end across API, data model, and UI
Design schemas and write migrations for new modules
Add tests at the unit and integration levels
Handle a share of production support and bug triage

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: Tidewater Cloud provides a managed backup service for cloud databases. As a senior full-stack engineer you will lead features that span the control-plane API and the customer console. You will own technical design and guide two other engineers through delivery.
responsibilities: Lead design and delivery of cross-stack features
Build control-plane endpoints and the React console that drives them
Define observability and rollback plans for each launch
Review pull requests and mentor mid-level engineers

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description: Polderworks is expanding its civic-tech products into Ireland and needs a full-stack engineer for the Dublin team. You will build permit and licensing workflows across a Python backend and a Vue frontend. Public-sector accessibility and audit requirements shape much of the work.
responsibilities: Implement licensing workflows from form to database to notification
Build audit logging and export features for government reviewers
Write integration tests covering full request flows
Coordinate with a designer on accessible form patterns

title: Software Engineering Intern, Full-Stack
description: Wren & Vale builds a marketplace for vintage furniture. As a full-stack intern you will ship small, user-visible features across the Next.js app and its API under mentorship. You will present your term project to the whole engineering team.
responsibilities: Build small features across the frontend and API with guidance
Write tests and update documentation for your work
Participate in code review and team standups

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Basalt Platform runs the internal developer platform for a 400-person fintech. You will own the Kubernetes foundations, CI/CD templates, and the paved paths other teams build on. Success looks like other engineers shipping faster without filing tickets.
responsibilities: Operate and upgrade multi-cluster Kubernetes environments
Build reusable CI/CD pipeline templates and service scaffolds
Set and enforce infrastructure standards through code
Run incident response and lead blameless postmortems

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: Cloudberry Infra provides managed data-platform hosting for analytics teams. You will build and maintain the Terraform modules and automation that provision customer environments. The job is heavy on IaC, networking, and cost control.
responsibilities: Write and maintain Terraform modules for customer stacks
Automate provisioning, upgrades, and teardown workflows
Tune cloud spend and surface cost anomalies
Document infrastructure patterns for the support team

title: Staff Platform Engineer, Reliability
description: Ironwood Exchange needs a staff engineer to lead reliability across its trading and settlement platform. You will set SLOs, drive the reliability roadmap, and be the technical anchor during major incidents. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a management one.
responsibilities: Define SLOs and error budgets with each product team
Lead the reliability roadmap and capacity planning
Act as incident commander for severity-one events
Coach engineers on operability and safe deployment practice
Own the observability platform and its standards

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description: Tanglewood Compute rents GPU capacity to research labs. You will keep the scheduling and provisioning services reliable while the fleet grows quickly. Expect deep work on autoscaling, hardware-failure handling, and noisy-neighbor problems.
responsibilities: Own reliability of the GPU scheduling and provisioning services
Build automated remediation for common hardware failures
Improve autoscaling to track bursty research workloads
Lead postmortems and track follow-up actions to done

title: Senior MLOps Engineer
description: Saffronworks builds fraud-detection models for payment processors. As senior MLOps engineer you will own the training-to-production pipeline: feature store, model registry, deployment, and monitoring. Your job is to make model updates boring and safe.
responsibilities: Operate the feature store and training orchestration
Build canary and shadow deployment paths for new models
Instrument drift, latency, and business-metric monitoring
Codify rollback and incident procedures for model regressions

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Brightkelp Data's ML team needs an MLOps engineer to tame a sprawl of notebooks and cron jobs. You will move training into a reproducible pipeline and give the team a real model registry. It is greenfield platform work with immediate impact.
responsibilities: Migrate ad-hoc training scripts into orchestrated pipelines
Stand up experiment tracking and a model registry
Containerize training and inference environments
Add CI checks for data and model validation

title: Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer
description: Kopitiam Cloud provides regional AI infrastructure for Southeast Asian banks. You will build the shared ML platform: GPU scheduling, model serving, and governance controls that satisfy local regulators. The role balances platform engineering with compliance-driven design.
responsibilities: Build multi-tenant model serving with quota and isolation
Integrate audit logging and access controls for model use
Automate GPU scheduling across training and inference
Partner with risk teams on model-governance requirements

title: Data Engineer
description: Prairiepoint Data runs the analytics warehouse for a national restaurant group. You will build and maintain the batch pipelines that turn point-of-sale and labor data into finance-ready tables. Data-quality checks and clear lineage are a big part of the role.
responsibilities: Build batch ELT pipelines from source systems into the warehouse
Model finance and operations tables with dbt
Add data-quality tests and monitor freshness
Support analysts with documented, trustworthy datasets

title: Senior Data Engineer, Streaming
description: Cascadia Streams provides real-time analytics for connected-vehicle fleets. As a senior data engineer you will own the streaming backbone that ingests millions of events per minute and serves them to downstream models and dashboards. Backpressure, exactly-once semantics, and schema evolution are daily concerns.
responsibilities: Design and operate Kafka-based ingestion and processing topologies
Build stream-processing jobs with strong delivery guarantees
Manage the schema registry and safe schema evolution
Lead capacity planning and cost optimization for the pipeline

title: Data Engineer
description: Banyan Compute builds a customer-data platform for Indian direct-to-consumer brands. You will develop the pipelines that unify web, app, and order data into clean customer profiles. The work spans batch and near-real-time processing on GCP.
responsibilities: Build identity-resolution and profile-unification pipelines
Develop batch and streaming jobs on managed GCP services
Write transformation models and tests in dbt
Monitor pipeline health and resolve data incidents

title: Engineering Lead, ML Platform
description: Lionfish Data builds a feature platform for real-time personalization. As engineering lead for ML Platform you will guide a team of five while staying hands-on in design and code review. You own delivery of the roadmap and the growth of the engineers on the team.
responsibilities: Lead planning and delivery for the ML platform team
Stay hands-on through design docs and code review
Coach engineers and run career-development conversations
Align the roadmap with data science and product stakeholders
Own on-call health and operational quality for the team's services

title: Engineering Manager, Data Platform
description: Cascadia Streams is scaling its data organization and needs an engineering manager for the data-platform group. You will manage six engineers across the streaming and warehouse teams, own hiring, and be accountable for delivery and reliability. This is a people-leadership role with light hands-on work.
responsibilities: Manage and grow a team of six data and platform engineers
Own quarterly planning, delivery, and stakeholder communication
Run hiring, onboarding, and performance management
Partner with product and analytics leaders on priorities
Be accountable for pipeline reliability and incident follow-through
